summary: This RFC defines multipart/report, a MIME media type serving as a general container for email reports of any kind. It is described here only for delivery status reports, but one type for all reports helps mail software. It is on the standards track and obsoletes RFC 3462.

eli5.summary: An envelope that holds a note and extra papers together. Mail systems use it to bundle a message saying that delivery failed, along with the details.

questions: what is a delivery status report container
